q = QuantumRegister(3)
c = ClassicalRegister(3)
qc = QuantumCircuit(q, c)

# Initialize q0 with |1⟩
qc.x(q[0])

# Create a Bell pair on q1 and q2
qc.h(q[1])
qc.cx(q[1], q[2])

qc.barrier()

# Alice's operations
qc.cx(q[0], q[1])
qc.h(q[0])

# Measure q0 and q1
qc.measure(q[0], c[0])
qc.measure(q[1], c[1])

qc.barrier()

# Apply conditional operations based on classical bits
qc.cx(q[1], q[2])
qc.cz(q[0], q[2])

qc.barrier()

# Measure q2
qc.measure(q[2], c[2])

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister, ClassicalRegister

qreg = QuantumRegister(4, 'q')
creg = ClassicalRegister(4, 'c')
circuit = QuantumCircuit(qreg, creg)

# Apply identity to qubit 0
circuit.i(qreg[0])

# Apply Z to qubit 1
circuit.z(qreg[1])

# Apply X to qubit 2
circuit.x(qreg[2])

# Apply Y to qubit 3
circuit.y(qreg[3])
